title: Hold a licence for aquaculture above the capacity limit
what: Undertake aquaculture above the aquaculture capacity limit only under a licence, and follow the aquaculture guidelines.

sources.title: Fisheries Act 2000 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 49(2) (current republication (R26, from 26 November 2025; Fisheries Act 2000 | Acts))
sources.quote: (b) the capacity of the structure used to contain fish for the aquaculture is more than the aquaculture capacity limit; and (c) the person does not hold a licence authorising the person to undertake the aquaculture
